keys: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: Volver al golpe de la lección

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: Revenir au coup de la leçon

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: Zurück zum Stoß der Lektion

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: Torna al colpo della lezione

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: Voltar à tacada da lição

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: Voltar à tacada da lição

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: レッスンの撞き方に戻す

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: 레슨의 샷으로 돌아가기

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: 回到课上的击球

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: Вернуть удар из урока

translations.key: Back to the lesson's stroke
translations.text: العودة إلى ضربة الدرس

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: Devuelve las bolas a su sitio con la puntería, la potencia y el efecto de la lección

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: Remet les billes en place avec la visée, la puissance et l'effet de la leçon

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: Legt die Kugeln zurück, mit dem Ziel, der Kraft und dem Effet der Lektion

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: Rimette a posto le palle con la mira, la potenza e l'effetto della lezione

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: Repõe as bolas com a pontaria, a força e o efeito da lição

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: Recoloca as bolas com a mira, a força e o efeito da lição

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: 球を元の位置に戻し、レッスンの狙い・強さ・回転にします

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: 공을 제자리로 되돌리고 레슨의 조준·힘·회전으로 맞춥니다

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: 把球放回原位，换回课上的瞄准、力度和旋转

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: Возвращает шары на место с прицелом, силой и вращением из урока

translations.key: Puts the balls back with the lesson's own aim, power and spin
translations.text: يعيد الكرات إلى مكانها مع تصويب الدرس وقوته ودورانه

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: Ahora todos los controles menos la potencia están libres y las marcas son tenues. La potencia se queda en la del golpe de la lección.

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: Toutes les commandes sauf la puissance sont libres maintenant, et les repères sont pâles. La puissance reste celle du coup de la leçon.

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: Jetzt sind alle Regler außer der Kraft frei, und die Markierungen sind blass. Die Kraft bleibt die vom Stoß der Lektion.

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: Ora tutti i comandi tranne la potenza sono liberi e i segni sono tenui. La potenza resta quella del colpo della lezione.

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: Agora todos os controlos menos a força estão livres e as marcas são ténues. A força fica a da tacada da lição.

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: Agora todos os controles menos a força estão livres e as marcas estão fracas. A força fica a da tacada da lição.

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: 強さ以外の操作が自由になり、印は薄くなりました。強さはレッスンの撞き方のままです。

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: 이제 힘을 뺀 모든 조작이 열려 있고 표시는 흐려졌어요. 힘은 레슨의 샷 그대로예요.

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: 现在除了力度，所有控制都可调，标记变淡了。力度保持课上击球的力度。

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: Теперь открыты все настройки, кроме силы, а отметки бледные. Сила остаётся как в ударе из урока.

translations.key: Every control but the power is open now, and the marks are faint. The power stays at the lesson's stroke.
translations.text: كل أدوات التحكم مفتوحة الآن ما عدا القوة، والعلامات باهتة. تبقى القوة كما في ضربة الدرس.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Ya no hay marcas. Todo es tuyo menos la potencia, que se queda en la del golpe de la lección. Consíguelo tú solo para aprobar.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Plus de repères. Tout est à toi sauf la puissance, qui reste celle du coup de la leçon. Réussis-le seul pour valider.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Jetzt keine Markierungen mehr. Alles außer der Kraft liegt bei dir, die Kraft bleibt die vom Stoß der Lektion. Schaff es allein, um zu bestehen.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Niente più segni. Tutto è in mano tua tranne la potenza, che resta quella del colpo della lezione. Riuscici da solo per superarla.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Já sem marcas. Tudo é contigo menos a força, que fica a da tacada da lição. Consegue sozinho para passar.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Agora sem marcas. Tudo fica com você menos a força, que fica a da tacada da lição. Acerte sozinho para passar.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: もう印はありません。強さ以外はすべて自分で決めよう。強さはレッスンの撞き方のままです。自分だけで決めて合格しよう。

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: 이제 표시가 없어요. 힘을 뺀 나머지는 모두 직접 정하고, 힘은 레슨의 샷 그대로예요. 혼자 성공해서 통과하세요.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: 现在没有标记了。除了力度，其他都由你来定，力度保持课上击球的力度。独立打成就能过关。

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Отметок больше нет. Всё, кроме силы, решаешь ты, а сила остаётся как в ударе из урока. Сделай сам, чтобы сдать.

translations.key: No marks now. Everything but the power is yours, and the power stays at the lesson's stroke. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: لا علامات الآن. كل شيء بيدك ما عدا القوة، فهي تبقى كما في ضربة الدرس. نفّذها بنفسك لتجتاز.
